intro.body:
At TPLUM Photography, we believe every image holds a story deeper than the moment it captures. Our work blends artistic vision with genuine emotion, creating photographs that feel timeless, expressive, and real.

From intimate portraits to bold brand visuals, we tell stories with intention—using light, composition, and mood to transform simple moments into lasting impressions.

Rooted in creativity and professionalism, TPLUM Photography delivers authentic visuals that elevate every subject and bring every story to life.

profile.heading: Hi, I’m Jeremy.
profile.body:
I’m the creative lead behind Tplum Photography, based in Alberta and available worldwide. Alongside a trusted creative team, I document weddings and events for couples and clients who value authenticity, connection, and timeless storytelling.

Your wedding day is more than an event; it’s one of the most meaningful chapters of your life. Every glance, every laugh, and every quiet in-between moment deserves to be preserved with intention. Choosing the right photographer isn’t just a decision, it’s an investment in how your story will be remembered.

My approach is effortless and intentional. I create a relaxed space where you can be fully present, while capturing your day with honesty, elegance, and a refined, timeless aesthetic. When you look back at your images, I want you to feel them, the warmth in every smile, the emotions that define you, and the atmosphere that made your day unmistakably yours, as if you’re stepping back into the moment.

With over 10 years of experience, I know when to gently guide and when to quietly step back. I blend in seamlessly, connect naturally with my couples and clients, and document your day without ever making it about me because your story should always take center stage.

When I’m not behind the camera, I spend meaningful time with family, drawing inspiration from the moments that matter most.

At the heart of everything I do is a deep belief in preserving memories. Every photograph is a piece of your story, and my greatest joy is delivering a collection of images that allows you to relive your day, moment by moment, for years to come.

intro.body: At tplum Photography, we don’t just photograph weddings, we preserve love stories. Every moment is captured with intention, emotion, and a timeless touch. From our first conversation to the delivery of your final gallery, our experience is crafted to feel effortless, personal, and memorable. Think of us as your behind-the-scenes storytellers, there to celebrate you, cheer you on, and capture you at your absolute best.

steps.title: 1. The Consultation
steps.body: Every successful wedding coverage begins with a clear and thoughtful consultation. During our initial meeting, we take the time to understand you as a couple, your vision for the day, and the moments that are most important to you. We’ll review your wedding details, address any questions, and confirm that our approach aligns with your expectations to ensure a smooth and well-planned experience.

steps.title: 2. Booking & Securing Your Date
steps.body: Once you decide to proceed, reserving your wedding date is straightforward. Your date is officially secured upon receipt of a signed contract and retainer. After booking, we schedule a personalized planning call and provide a tailored wedding guide with timelines, tips, and professional insights to ensure a well-organized and seamless experience.

steps.title: 3. Engagement Session
steps.body: If your wedding photography package includes an engagement session, this will be our next conversation. This session is a great way for us to get to know each other before the wedding day. It’s a relaxed experience designed to naturally capture your love story, and the resulting images are perfect for save-the-dates, wedding decoration, or personal keepsakes.

steps.title: 4. Pre-Wedding Check-In
steps.body: As your wedding day approaches, we’ll schedule a thoughtful check-in to fine-tune your photography timeline, review final details, and ensure every element aligns seamlessly with your vision. This final check-in helps us to anticipate each moment with care, so you can step into your wedding day feeling fully prepared, confident, and effortlessly at ease, knowing nothing has been overlooked.

steps.title: 5. Your Wedding Day
steps.body: This is your moment. Our team arrives with care and intention, capturing everything from intimate moments to joyful celebrations. Blending refined artistry with a documentary approach, we preserve the emotions and details that tell your story beautifully and timelessly.

steps.title: 6. Post-Wedding Magic
steps.body: After your wedding, we carefully curate and refine your images to capture the beauty, emotion, and elegance of your day. You’ll receive a sneak peek within a few days, with your full high-resolution gallery delivered within four weeks, timeless, polished, and ready to be cherished.

steps.title: 7. Your love Story in Print
steps.body: Your wedding images deserve to be more than just digital files, they deserve to become cherished. We offer exquisitely crafted luxury albums and fine art prints, transforming your memories into tangible works of art. With our guidance, you’ll select the perfect images to create a stunning, timeless album that tells your story beautifully for generations to treasure.

steps.title: 8. More Than Clients—Beyond the Wedding
steps.body: At Tplum Photography, our work goes beyond capturing your wedding day. We strive to build genuine, lasting relationships, celebrating the milestones, memories, and moments that make your story unique. Even after the wedding, we’re here to connect, support, and capture life’s chapters, whether through anniversaries, family portraits, or simply sharing in your journey together.

items.question: HOW DO WE BOOK YOU?
items.answer: Kindly fill out the form in the bookings tab, or click here. We will contact you shortly.

items.question: HOW SOON SHOULD WE BOOK?
items.answer: We recommend booking early, as our calendar tends to fill up quickly.

items.question: DO YOU GIVE POSING DIRECTION?
items.answer: Yes, we intentionally guide our couples with posing to create beautiful, timeless images. Alongside guided posing, we focus on documenting natural, candid moments that reflect the true emotions, joy and rich story of your day.

items.question: DO YOU RETOUCH YOUR IMAGES?
items.answer: Absolutely. However, not excessive to the point where you don't look natural. We focus on showcasing our unique tone and styles, embracing some imperfections to reflect genuine and relatable experiences. If there are specific editing requests, we are happy to discuss. This includes light skin smoothing, blemish removal, etc.

items.question: HOW MANY HOURS OF COVERAGE ARE INCLUDED?
items.answer: Our standard wedding/event coverage includes up to 12 hours, ensuring we capture every key moment from start to finish.

items.question: WHAT’S INCLUDED IN YOUR PHOTOGRAPHY PACKAGES?
items.answer: Each package includes a set number of hours, professionally edited images, and an online gallery. Additional services like photobook and extra coverage are available.

items.question: WHEN WILL I RECEIVE MY IMAGES?
items.answer:
Engagement Sessions take 5-7 days after selection.
Weddings take 4 weeks
However, we understand the excitement of reliving your special day! That's why we send a few sneak peek images during the first week after your wedding.

items.question: HOW MANY IMAGES WILL I RECEIVE?
items.answer: This varies based on the scope of the wedding, such as number of hours booked. Number of images can range from 400-1500 photos.

items.question: DO YOU OFFER ENGAGEMENT SHOOTS? IS IT INCLUDED?
items.answer: Yes, we do offer engagement shoots. It's a great way for us to get to know each other before the big day, and it helps you both get comfortable in front of the camera. We will also guide you on locations, mood boards, and the best time to shoot.

items.question: DO YOU HAVE A TEAM?
items.answer: Yes, we do! We work with a trusted team of second shooters and videographers and assistants to ensure everything runs smoothly, especially for larger weddings. Everyone we work with is professionally trained and shares our approach and style, so you’ll get a seamless experience throughout the day.

items.question: DO YOU OFFER ALBUMS OR WEDDING PHOTO-FRAMES?
items.answer: Yes, we do offer both photo books and framed prints! We have a range of high-quality photo books that are perfect for preserving your images in a beautiful, tangible format. We also offer a selection of frames and wall art options in various sizes and finishes.

items.question: DO YOU ONLY SHOOT WEDDINGS?
items.answer: We also provide maternity, studio portraits, proposals, engagement, and corporate event photography.

items.question: DO YOU TRAVEL?
items.answer: Yes we do! Please reach out to us to discuss travel details with you.

items.question: HOW MANY PEOPLE ON YOUR TEAM WILL BE AT MY WEDDING?
items.answer: One or two photographes and a light assistant depending on the package you opt for.

items.question: DO WE OWN THE RIGHTS TO THE IMAGES?
items.answer: Once your photos are delivered, you receive personal usage rights, which means you’re free to share, print, and enjoy them for personal purposes. However, the copyright remains with the photographer. This allows us to use the images for our portfolio, website, and promotional materials, but rest assured, we’ll always respect your privacy and never share sensitive moments without your consent. If you have any concerns about this, we can always discuss it during consultations.
